first_read_definition: Earliest successful recorded executed command containing an explicit diagnostic path and a cat/sed/grep/rg/head/tail command or read_text/read_bytes. This is a limited observable proxy, not exact first understanding or localization accuracy. Broad searches or aliases may be missed.
decision: Preserve all six outcomes; no tuning/reruns in this batch. Analyze failures as localization, action stagnation, context pressure, provider/environment or verification failures; keep retrieval optional without broad claims.
